prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a production 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet, SIX separate whole-body poses, true transparent RGBA background. Input image 1 is the EXACT approved running character, identity/rendering reference. Image 2 is jump anatomy reference only. Preserve image 1 character: oversized ROUND warm ivory head, one black oval eye near right edge, soft matte paper grain, short anatomical legs and plain shorts, long layered broad paper cloak about 10% darker than body. BOTH arms/hands entirely hidden inside the cloak. No visible hands. Near leg bright ivory, far leg darker taupe. All SIX face RIGHT in strict SIDE PROFILE with head leading hips and torso pitched forward about 20 degrees from vertical, like a RUNNING FORWARD LEAP, not upright stationary hopping, not lying flat. Cloak streams behind to the LEFT with soft rounded folds. Preserve head shape and body proportions, no noodle limbs, no rigged cutouts, no heavy new detail or added lines. Entire full body and cape in each cell with generous margins. All equal scale/head width; keep cape length manageable inside each cell. No grid, text, ground, shadows or trails. Background genuinely transparent.
Reading order:
1 top-left: immediate PUSH-OFF FROM RUN, torso already inclined forward, front short knee tucked forward, rear leg finishing pushing behind with toe lowest; keep momentum, no crouch pause.
2 top-middle: RISING FORWARD LEAP, both short legs airborne, front thigh folded up toward belly, back knee folds under pelvis, head leads, cape flows behind.
3 top-right: APEX OF FORWARD LEAP, both short knees tucked closer to body, calves folded back, compact and agile, torso still forward, not upright; cloak floats behind left.
4 bottom-left: DESCENDING FORWARD, near knee reaches slightly forward but remains bent, near foot lowers for landing, far leg tucked behind, torso keeps forward pitch and cape trails behind.
5 bottom-middle: RUNNING LANDING CONTACT, near bright foot plants under head with bent knee, far foot tucked behind, forward pitched body absorbs contact while immediately continuing running. Do not show both feet planted.
6 bottom-right: EXIT CONTACT INTO RUN, near planted leg pushes ground backward, far darker knee advances forward under cloak to start next stride; torso remains in same forward-leaning angle as original running reference.
Keep every head same scale and visual identity, no stretching/squashing head or body. This is a whole-frame drawn animation, not separate limb assets. The jump progresses horizontally in game; sheet contains poses only, not a scene. Frame6 should closely match original running silhouette.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact six-pose sprite sheet: remove ALL of the brown/black background AND all glow/halo around the characters, producing genuinely transparent RGBA alpha. Keep all six character drawings, their opaque interiors, exact pose, colors, shapes, texture, location and size completely unchanged. No redraw, no white background, no checkerboard painted into pixels. True alpha 0 outside the six silhouettes with clean antialiased edges. Preserve the 3 columns by 2 rows layout and canvas dimensions. Do not crop.

processing: Crop six full drawings, uniformly scale head width to 160px and register to the run pivot; preserve generated alpha. No joint rig or body rotation.
